Allah Ta'ala munafiqon ke nifaq ko zahir karta hai ke goya tere paas aa kar qasmein kha kha kar apne Islam ka izhaar karte hain, teri risalat ka iqrar karte hain, magar darasal dil ke khote hain. Fi-waqai Aap Rasulullah bhi hain, un ka yeh qaul bhi hai magar chunke dil mein is ka koi asar nahi, lehaza yeh jhoote hain. Yeh tujhe Rasulullah maante hain, is bare mein agar yeh sache hone ke liye qasmein bhi khayein lekin Aap yaqeen na kijiye. Yeh qasmein to un ke bayen hath ka khel hai, yeh to apne jhoot ko sach banane ka ek zariya hain, maqsad yeh hai ke musalman un se hoshyar rahein, kahin unhein sacha imandar samajh kar kisi baat mein un ki taqlid na karne lagein ke yeh Islam ke rang mein tum ko kufr ka irtikab kara dein, yeh bad-amal log Allah ki rah se door hain. 

Dahhak ki qirat mein iman-hum alif ki zer ke sath hai to matlab yeh hoga ke unhon ne apni zahiri tasdiq ko apne liye taqqiya bana liya hai ke qatl se aur hukm-e-kufr se duniya mein bach jayein. Yeh nifaq un ke dilon mein is gunah ki shoomi ke baais rach gaya hai ke iman se phir kar kufr ki taraf aur hidayat se hat kar zalalat ki janib aa gaye hain, ab dilon par mohr-e-ilahi lag chuki hai aur baat ki teh ko pahunchne ki qabiliyat salib ho chuki hai. Bazahir to khush-ro khush-go hain, is fasahat aur balaghat se guftugu karte hain ke khwah- مخwah dusre ke dil ko mail kar lein, lekin batin mein bare khote, bare kamzor dil wale, namard aur bad-niyat hain. Jahan koi bhi waqia ronma hua aur samajh baithe ke haye mare, aur jagah hai "Ashihhatan alaikum..." tumhare muqable mein bukhl karte hain, phir jis waqt khauf hota hai to tumhari taraf is tarah aankhein pher pher kar dekhte hain goya kisi shakhs par maut ki behoshi tari hai, phir jab khauf chala jata hai to tumhein apni bad-kalami se izaa dete hain aur maal-e-ghanimat ki hirs mein na kehne ki baatein keh guzarte hain. Yeh be-iman hain, un ke aamal gharat hain, Allah par yeh amr nihayat hi aasan hai. 

Pas in ki yeh aawazein khali pait ke dhol ki buland-bang se ziyada wuqat nahi rakhti, yehi tumhare dushman hain, un ki chakni chupri baatein aur siqa aur miskeen suratoun ke dhoke mein na aa jana, Allah unhein barbad kare, zara sochein to kyun hidayat ko chhod kar be-rahi par chal rahe hain? 

Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: Munafiqon ki bahut si alamaten hain jin se woh pehchan liye jaate hain; un ka salam laanat hai, un ki khurak loot-maar hai, un ki ghanimat haram aur khayanat hai, woh masjidon ki nazdiki naapasand karte hain, woh namazon ke liye aakhri waqt aate hain, takabbur aur nahwat wale hote hain, narmi aur suluk tawazu aur inkisari se mahroom hote hain, na khud in kaamon ko karein na dusron ke in kaamon ko wuqat ki nigaah se dekhein. Raat ki lakdiyan aur din ke shor-o-ghal karne wale. Aur riwayat mein hai: Din ko khoob khane peene wale aur raat ko khushk lakdiyon ki tarah pad rehne wale.

Munafiqon ki mahrumi-e-saadat ke asbab mal'un munafiqon ka zikr ho raha hai ke unke gunahon par jab unse sachche musalman kehte hain ke aao Rasul-e-Karim (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tumhare liye istighfar karenge toh Allah Ta'ala tumhare gunah maaf farma dega toh yeh takabbur ke sath sar hilane lagte hain aur i'raz karte hain aur ruk jate hain aur is baat ko haqarat ke sath radd kar dete hain, iska badla yahi hai ke ab unke liye bakhshish ke darwaze band hain Nabi ka istighfar bhi unhe kuch nafa na dega, bhala in fasiqon ki qismat mein hidayat kahan?

Surah Bara'at mein bhi isi mazmoon ki aayat guzar chuki hai aur wahin iski tafsir aur sath hi iske mutaliq ki hadeethein bhi bayan kar di gayi hain, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Sufyan rawi ne apna munh dayen janib pher liya tha aur ghazab-o-takabbur ke sath tirchi aankh se ghoor kar dikhaya tha isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai aur salaf mein se aksar hazraat ka farman hai ke yeh sab ka sab bayan Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul ka hai jaise ke anqareeb aa raha hai Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Sirat Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul apni qaum ka bada aur shareef shakhs tha jab Nabi ﷺ jumma ke din khutbah ke liye mimar par baithte thay toh yeh khada ho jata tha aur kehta tha logon yeh hain Allah ke Rasool ﷺ jo tum mein maujood hain jin ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala ne tumhara ikram kiya aur tumhein izrat di ab tum par farz hai ke tum aap ki madad karo aur aap ki izzat-o-takreem karo aap ka farman suno aur jo farmayein baja lao yeh keh kar baith jaya karta tha. Uhud ke maidan mein is ka nifaq khul gaya aur yeh wahan se Huzoor ﷺ ki khuli nafarmani kar ke tihai lashkar ko le kar Madina ko wapas laut aaya jab Rasool Allah ﷺ Ghazwa-e-Uhud se farigh hue aur Madina mein ma-l-khair tashreef laye jumma ka din aaya aur aap mimar par chadhe toh hasab-e-aadat yeh aaj bhi khada hua aur kehna chahta hi tha ke ba'az sahaba idhar udhar se khade ho gaye aur is ke kapde pakad kar kehne lage dushman-e-Khuda baith ja toh ab yeh kehne ka munh nahi rakhta tune jo kuch kiya woh kisi se makhfi nahi ab to is ka ahal nahi ke zubaan mein jo jee mein aaye bak de, yeh naraaz ho kar logon ki gardanein phalangta hua bahar nikal gaya aur kehta jata tha ke goya main kisi badi baat ke kehne ke liye khada hua tha main toh is ka kaam aur mazboot karne ke liye khada hua tha jo chand ashab mujh par uchhal kar aa gaye mujhe ghasitne lage aur dant-dapat karne lage goya ke main kisi badi baat ke kehne ke liye khada hua tha halankeh meri niyat yeh thi ke main aap ki baaton ki taayid karun. Unhon ne kaha khair ab tum wapas chalo hum Rasool Allah ﷺ se arz karenge aap tumhare liye Allah se bakhshish chahenge us ne kaha mujhe koi zaroorat nahi.

Hazrat Qatada aur Hazrat Suddi farmate hain ke yeh aayat Abdullah bin Ubayy ke bare mein utri hai, waqya yeh tha ke isi ki qaum ke ek naujawan musalman ne is ki aisi hi chand buri baatein Rasool Allah ﷺ tak pahunchai thin, Huzoor ﷺ ne bulwaya toh yeh saaf inkaar kar gaya aur qasmein kha gaya, ansariyon ne sahabi ko malamat aur dant-dapat ki aur use jhoota samjha is par yeh aayetein utrin aur is munafiq ki jhooti qasmon aur us naujawan sahabi ki sachai ka Allah Ta'ala ne bayan farmaya, ab is se kaha gaya ke tu chal aur Rasool Allah ﷺ se istighfar kara toh is ne inkaar ke lehje mein sar hila diya aur na gaya.

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke jis manzil mein utarte wahan se koch na karte jab tak namaz na padh lein, Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein Huzoor ﷺ ko khabar pahunchi ke Abdullah bin Ubayy keh raha hai ke hum izzat wale in zillat walon ko Madina pahunch kar nikal denge, pas aap ne aakhri din mein utarne se pehle hi koch kar diya, is se kaha gaya ke Huzoor ﷺ ke paas ja kar apni khata ki muafiyi Allah se talab kar, is ka bayan is aayat mein hai. Is ki asnad Saeed bin Jubair tak sahih hai lekin yeh kehna ke yeh waqya Ghazwa-e-Tabuk ka hai is mein nazar hai balkeh yeh theek nahi hai is liye ke Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul toh is ghazwa mein tha hi nahi balkeh lashkar ki ek jamaat ko le kar yeh toh laut gaya tha. Kutab-e-Sairo-Maghazi ke musannifein mein toh yeh mashhoor hai ke yeh waqya Ghazwa-e-Marisi'a yani Ghazwa-e-Banu Al-Mustaliq ka hai, chunanche is qissa mein Hazrat Muhammad bin Yahya bin Habban aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Abu Bakr aur Hazrat Asim bin Umar bin Qatada se marwi hai ke is ladai ke mauqa par Huzoor ﷺ ka ek jagah qiyam tha, wahan Hazrat Jahjah bin Saeed Al-Ghafari aur Hazrat Sinan bin Yazeed ka pani ke izdiham par kuch jhagda ho gaya, Jahjah Hazrat Umar ke karande thay, jhagde ne tool pakda, Sinan ne ansariyon ko apni madad ke liye aawaz di aur Jahjah ne muhajireen ko. Us waqt Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam waghera ansari ki ek jamaat Abdullah bin Ubayy ke paas baithi hui thi, us ne jab yeh faryad suni toh kehne laga lo hamare hi shahron mein in logon ne hum par hamle shuru kar diye, Allah ki qasam hamari aur in Quraish ki misal wahi hai jo kisi ne kaha hai ke apne kutte ko mota taza kar ke tujhe hi kaate, Allah ki qasam agar hum laut kar Madina gaye toh hum zi-maqdoor log in be-maqdoron ko wahan se nikal denge. Phir is ki qaum ke jo log is ke paas baithe thay un se kehne laga yeh sab aafat tum ne khud apne haathon apne upar li hai tum ne unhein apne shahar mein basaya tum ne unhein apne maal aadhoon aadh hisse diye ab bhi agar tum in ki mali madad na karo toh yeh khud tang aa kar Madina se nikal bhagenge. 

Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam R.A ne yeh tamam baatein sunin aap us waqt bohat kam umr thay seedhe Sarkar-e-Nubuwwat mein hazir hue aur kul waqya bayan farmaya, us waqt aap ke paas Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A bhi baithe hue thay ghazabnak ho kar farmane lage ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Abad bin Bashir ko hukum farmayiye ke is ki gardan alag kar de. Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya phir toh logon mein yeh mashhoor ho jayega ke Muhammad ﷺ apne sathiyon ki gardanein marte hain yeh theek nahi jao logon mein koch ki munadi kar do. Abdullah bin Ubayy ko jab yeh maloom hua ke is ki guftagu ka ilm Anhadrat ﷺ ko ho gaya toh bohat sat-pataya aur Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar uzr-o-ma'azrat aur heelay hawale taweel aur tehreef karne laga aur qasmein kha gaya ke main ne aisa hargiz nahi kaha, chunanche yeh shakhs apni qaum mein zi-izzat aur ba-waqqaat tha aur log bhi kehne lage Huzoor ﷺ shayad is bachche ne hi galti ki ho use wahm ho gaya ho waqya sabit toh hota nahi. Huzoor ﷺ yahan se jaldi hi koch ke waqt se pehle hi tashreef le chale raste mein Hazrat Usayd bin Huzair R.A mile aur aap ke shaan-e-nubuwwat ke qabil ba-adab salam kiya phir arz ki ke Huzoor ﷺ aaj kya baat hai ke waqt se pehle hi janaab ne koch kiya? Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya kya tumhein maloom nahi ke tumhare sathi Ibn Abi ne kya kaha woh kehta hai ke Madina ja kar hum azeez in zaleelon ko nikal denge. Hazrat Usayd ne kaha ya Rasool Allah ﷺ izzat wale aap hain aur zaleel woh hai ya Rasool Allah ﷺ aap is ki in baaton ka khayal bhi na farmayiye darasal yeh bohat jala hua hai suniye Ahl-e-Madina ne ise sardar banane par ittefaq kar liya tha taaj tayyar ho raha tha ke Allah Rabbul Izzat aap ko laya is ke hath se mulk nikal gaya pas yeh chiragh-pa ho raha hai. Huzoor ﷺ chalte rahe, dopahar ko hi chal diye thay shaam hui raat hui subah hui yahan tak ke dhoop mein tezi aa gayi tab aap ne padao kiya taake log is baat mein phir na ulajh jayen, chunanche tamam log thake hare aur raat ke jage hue thay utarte hi sab so gaye idhar yeh soorat nazil hui (Sirat Ibn Ishaq).

Baihaqi mein hai ke hum ek ghazwe mein Huzoor ﷺ ke sath thay ek muhajir ne ek ansari ko patthar maar diya is par baat badh gayi aur donon ne apni apni jamaat se faryad ki aur unhein pukara. Huzoor ﷺ sar-e-naraaz hue aur farmane lage yeh kya jahiliyat ki hank lagane lage is fazool kharab aadat ko chhodo, Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul kehne laga ab muhajir yeh karne lag gaye Allah ki qasam Madina pahunchte hi hum zi-izzat in zaleelon ko wahan se nikal bahar karenge. Us waqt Madina Shareef mein ansariyon ki tadad muhajireen se bohat zyada thi go baad mein muhajireen bohat zyada ho gaye thay. Hazrat Umar ko jab Ibn Abi ke is qaul ka ilm hua toh Huzoor ﷺ se is ke qatl karne ki ijazat chahi magar aap ne rok diya. Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam se marwi hai ke Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein main ne jab is munafiq ka yeh qaul Huzoor ﷺ ke samne bayan kiya aur is ne aa kar inkaar kiya aur qasmein kha gaya us waqt meri qaum ne mujhe bohat kuch bura kaha aur har tarah malamat ki ke main ne aisa kyun kiya?

Main nihayat ghamgeen dil ho kar wahan se chal diya aur sakht ranj-o-gham mein tha ki Huzoor ﷺ ne mujhe yaad farmaya aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne tera uzr nazil farmaya hai aur teri sachchai zahir ki hai aur yeh ayat utri Hum-ul-Lazeena al-kh, yeh hadis aur bhi bahut si kitabon mein hai, Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam ka yeh bayan is tarah hai ki main apne chacha ke sath ek ghazve mein tha aur main ne Abdullah bin Ubay ki yeh dono baten sunin main ne apne chacha se bayan kin aur mere chacha ne Huzoor ﷺ se arz kin jab Aap ne use bulaya us ne inkar kiya aur qasmein kha gayin. Huzoor ﷺ ne use sacha aur mujhe jhoota jana mere chacha ne bhi mujhe bura bhala kaha mujhe is qadar gham aur nadamat hui ki main ne ghar se bahar nikalna chhod diya yahan tak ki yeh surat utri aur Aap ne meri tasdeeq ki aur mujhe yeh padh sunai. Musnad ki aur riwayat mein hai ki ek safar ke mauqe par jab Sahaba ko tangi pahunchi toh us ne unhein kuch dene ki momanat kar di. Rasulullah ﷺ ne jab unhein is liye bulaya ki Aap un ke liye istighfar karein toh unhein ne us se bhi munh pher liya, Quran-e-Kareem ne unhein tek lagai hui lakdiyan is liye kaha hai ki yeh log achche jameel jism wale thay, Tirmizi waghaira mein Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam R.H se riwayat hai ki hum ek ghazve mein Huzoor ﷺ ke sath nikle hamare sath kuch A'rab log bhi thay pani ki jagah woh pehle pahunchna chahte thay isi tarah hum bhi isi ki koshish mein rehte thay ek martaba ek A'rabi ne ja kar pani par qabza kar ke hoz par kar liya aur us ke ird-gird patthar rakh diye aur upar se chamda phaila diya ek Ansari ne aa kar us hoz mein se apne oont ko pani pilana chaha us ne roka Ansari ne pilane par zor diya us ne ek lakdi utha kar Ansari ke sar par mari jis se us ka sar zakhmi ho gaya. Yeh chukeh Abdullah bin Ubay ka sathi tha seedha us ke paas aya aur tamam majra keh sunaya Abdullah bahut bigda aur kehne laga in A'rabiyon ko kuch na do yeh khud bhookhe marte bhag jayenge, yeh A'rabi khane ki quwwat Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aa jate thay aur kha liya karte thay toh Abdullah bin Ubay ne kaha tum Rasulullah ﷺ ka khana le kar aise waqt jao jab yeh log na hon Aap apne sathiyon ke sath kha lenge yeh reh jayenge yunhi bhookhon marte bhag jayenge aur ab hum Madina ja kar in kamino ko nikal bahar karenge, main us waqt Rasulullah ﷺ ka radeef tha aur main ne yeh sab suna apne chacha se zikr kiya chacha ne Huzoor ﷺ se zikr kiya Aap ne use bulaya yeh inkar kar gaya aur half utha liya Huzoor ﷺ ne use sacha samjha aur mujhe jhoota qarar diya mere chacha mere paas aaye aur kaha tum ne yeh kya harkat ki?

Huzoor ﷺ tujh par naraz ho gaye aur tujhe jhootha jana aur digar musalmanon ne bhi tujhe jhootha samjha, mujh par gham ka pahad toot pada, sakht gham-o-andoh ki halat mein sar jhukaye main Huzoor ﷺ ke sath ja raha tha. Thodi hi der guzri hogi ke aap mere paas aaye, mera kaan pakda, jab main ne sar utha kar aap ki taraf dekha to aap muskuraye aur chal diye, Allah ki qasam mujhe is qadar khushi hui ke bayan se bahar hai, agar duniya ki abadi zindagi mujhe mil jati jab bhi main itna khush na ho sakta tha. Phir Hazrat Siddique Akbar R.A mere paas aaye aur poocha ke An-Hazrat ﷺ ne tum se kya kaha? Main ne kaha: farmaya to kuch bhi nahi, muskurate huye tashreef le gaye. Aap ne farmaya: bas phir khush ho. Aap ke baad hi Hazrat Umar Farooq ؓ tashreef laye, yehi sawal mujh se kiya aur main ne yehi jawab diya. Subah ko Surah Munafiqun nazil hui. 

Dusri riwayat mein is surat ka Min-ha-azzil tak padhna bhi marwi hai, Abdullah bin Lahee'ah aur Musa bin Uqbah ne bhi isi hadith ko Maghazi mein bayan kiya hai lekin un donon ki riwayat mein khabar pahunchane wale ka naam Aus bin Aqram hai jo qabeela Bani Harith bin Khazraj mein se thay. Mumkin hai ke Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam ne bhi khabar pahunchai ho aur Hazrat Aus ne bhi, aur ye bhi mumkin hai ke rawi se naam mein ghalti ho gayi ho, Wallahu A'lam. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke yeh waqia Ghazwa-e-Muraisi' ka hai, yeh woh ghazwa hai jis mein Hazrat Khalid R.A ko bhej kar Huzoor ﷺ ne Manat بت ko tudwaya tha jo Qafa Masal aur samandar ke darmiyan tha. Isi ghazwa mein do shakhson ke darmiyan jhagda ho gaya tha, ek Muhajir tha dusra qabeela Bahz ka tha aur qabeela Bahz Ansarion ka haleef tha. Bahzi ne Ansarion ko aur Muhajir ne Muhajireen ko aawaz di, kuch log donon taraf khade ho gaye aur jhagda hone laga. Jab khatam hua to munafiq aur bimar dil log Abdullah bin Ubayy ke paas jama hue aur kehne lage: humein to tum se bahut kuch ummeedein thin, tum hamare dushmanon se hamara bachao thay, ab to bekaar ho gaye ho, nafa ka khayal na nuqsan ka, tum ne hi in jalaleeb ko itna chadha diya ke baat baat par yeh hum par chadh daudein. Naye Muhajireen ko yeh log jalaleeb kehte thay. 

Is dushman-e-Allah ne jawab diya ke ab Madine pahunchte hi in sab ko wahan se des nikala de denge. Malik bin Dukhshun jo munafiq tha us ne kaha: main to tumhe pehle hi se kehta hoon ke in logon ke sath salook karna chhod do, khud-ba-khud muntashir ho jayenge. Yeh baatein Hazrat Umar R.A ne sun leen aur khidmat-e-Nabawi mein aa kar arz karne lage ke is bani-e-fitna Abdullah bin Ubayy ka qissa paak karne ki mujhe ijazat dijiye. Aap ne farmaya: acha, agar ijazat doon toh kya tum ise qatal kar daaloge?

Hazrat Umar ne kaha Ya Rasulullah ﷺ Allah ki kasam abhi apne haath se iski gardan maarunga, Aap ne farmaya acha baith jaao itne mein Hazrat Usaid bin Huzair bhi yahi kehte hue aaye, Aap ne unse bhi yahi poocha aur unhone bhi yahi jawab diya, Aap ne unhe bhi bitha liya, Phir thodi der guzri hogi ke kooch karne ka hukum diya aur waqt se pehle hi lashkar ne kooch kiya, Woh din raat dusri subah barabar chalte hi rahe jab dhoop mein tezi aa gayi, utarne ko farmaya, Phir dopahar dhalte hi jaldi se kooch kiya aur isi tarah chalte rahe teesre din subah ko Qafa-e-Masal se Madina Sharif pahunch gaye, Hazrat Umar ko bulwaya, Unse poocha ke kya main iske qatal ka tujhe hukum deta toh tu ise maar daalta? Hazrat Umar ne arz kiya yaqeenan main iska sar tan se juda kar deta. Aap ne farmaya agar tu ise us din qatal kar daalta toh bahut se logo ke naak khaak alooda ho jaate, Main agar unhe kehta toh woh bhi ise maar daalne mein taammul na karte, Phir logo ko baatein banane ka mauqa milta ke Muhammad ﷺ apne sathiyein ko bhi bedardi ke sath maar daalta hai, Isi waqt ka bayaan in aayaton mein hai, Yeh siyaq bahut ghareeb hai aur ismein bahut si aisi umda baatein hain jo dusri rivayaton mein nahi, Sirat Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke Abdullah bin Ubayy munafiq ke bete Hazrat Abdullah R.A jo pake sache musalman the is waqe ke baad An-Hazrat ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur guzarish ki ke Ya Rasulullah ﷺ maine suna hai ke mere baap ne jo bakwaas ki hai uske badle aap ise qatal karna chahte hain, Agar yuhin hai toh iske qatal ka hukum aap kisi aur ko na kijiye, Main khud jaata hoon aur abhi iska sar aap ke kadmo tale daalta hoon, Qasam Allah ki qabila Khazraj ka ek ek shakhs jaanta hai ke mujhse zyada koi beta apne baap se ehsan-o-suluk aur mohabbat-o-izzat karne wala nahi (lekin main Farman-e-Rasul ﷺ par apne pyare baap ki gardan maarne ko taiyar hoon), Agar aap ne kisi aur ko yeh hukum diya aur usne ise maara toh mujhe dhar hai ke kahin josh-e-inteqam mein main ise na maar baithun aur zahir hai ke agar yeh harkat mujhse ho gayi toh main ek kafir ke badle ek musalman ko maar kar jahannami ban jaaunga, Aap mere baap ke qatal ka hukum dijiye, Aap ne farmaya nahi nahi main ise qatal karna nahi chahta, Hum toh isse aur narmi bartenge aur iske sath husn-o-suluk karenge jab tak woh hamare sath hai, Hazrat Ikrimah aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Zaid ka bayaan hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ apne lashkaro samet Madine pahunche toh is munafiq Abdullah bin Ubayy ke ladke Hazrat Abdullah R.A Madina Sharif ke darwaze par khade ho gaye, Talwaar khench li, Log Madina mein dakhil hone lage yahan tak ke unka baap aaya toh yeh farmane lage pare raho, Madina mein na jaao, Usne kaha kya baat hai? Mujhe kyun rok raha hai?

Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne farmaya tu Madina mein nahi ja sakta jab tak ke Allah ke Rasool ﷺ tere liye ijazat na dein, izzat wale aap hi hain aur tu zaleel hai, yeh ruk kar khada ho gaya yahan tak ke Rasool Kareem ﷺ tashreef laye aap ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke lashkar ke aakhiri hisse mein hote thay aap ko dekh kar us munafiq ne apne bete ki shikayat ki aap ne un se pucha ke ise kyun rok rakha hai? Unhone kaha qasam hai Allah ki jab tak aap ki ijazat na ho yeh andar nahi ja sakta chunacha Huzoor ﷺ ne ijazat di ab Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne apne baap ko shehar mein dakhil hone diya, Musnad Humaidi mein hai ke aap ne apne walid se kaha jab tak tu apni zaban se yeh na kahe ke Rasool Allah ﷺ عزت wale aur main zaleel to Madina mein nahi ja sakta aur is se pehle Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar arz kiya tha ke ya Rasool Allah ﷺ apne baap ki haibat ki wajah se main ne aaj tak nigaah oonchi kar ke un ke chehre ko bhi nahi dekha lekin aap agar is par naraz hain toh mujhe hukum dijiye abhi is ki gardan hazir karta hoon kisi aur ko is ke qatal ka hukum na dijiye aisa na ho ke main apne baap ke qatal ko apni aankhon se chalta phirta na dekh sakoon.

Munafiqon ki mahrumi-e-saadat ke asbab mal'un munafiqon ka zikr ho raha hai ke unke gunahon par jab unse sachche musalman kehte hain ke aao Rasul-e-Karim (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tumhare liye istighfar karenge toh Allah Ta'ala tumhare gunah maaf farma dega toh yeh takabbur ke sath sar hilane lagte hain aur i'raz karte hain aur ruk jate hain aur is baat ko haqarat ke sath radd kar dete hain, iska badla yahi hai ke ab unke liye bakhshish ke darwaze band hain Nabi ka istighfar bhi unhe kuch nafa na dega, bhala in fasiqon ki qismat mein hidayat kahan?

Surah Bara'at mein bhi isi mazmoon ki aayat guzar chuki hai aur wahin iski tafsir aur sath hi iske mutaliq ki hadeethein bhi bayan kar di gayi hain, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Sufyan rawi ne apna munh dayen janib pher liya tha aur ghazab-o-takabbur ke sath tirchi aankh se ghoor kar dikhaya tha isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai aur salaf mein se aksar hazraat ka farman hai ke yeh sab ka sab bayan Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul ka hai jaise ke anqareeb aa raha hai Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Sirat Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul apni qaum ka bada aur shareef shakhs tha jab Nabi ﷺ jumma ke din khutbah ke liye mimar par baithte thay toh yeh khada ho jata tha aur kehta tha logon yeh hain Allah ke Rasool ﷺ jo tum mein maujood hain jin ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala ne tumhara ikram kiya aur tumhein izrat di ab tum par farz hai ke tum aap ki madad karo aur aap ki izzat-o-takreem karo aap ka farman suno aur jo farmayein baja lao yeh keh kar baith jaya karta tha. Uhud ke maidan mein is ka nifaq khul gaya aur yeh wahan se Huzoor ﷺ ki khuli nafarmani kar ke tihai lashkar ko le kar Madina ko wapas laut aaya jab Rasool Allah ﷺ Ghazwa-e-Uhud se farigh hue aur Madina mein ma-l-khair tashreef laye jumma ka din aaya aur aap mimar par chadhe toh hasab-e-aadat yeh aaj bhi khada hua aur kehna chahta hi tha ke ba'az sahaba idhar udhar se khade ho gaye aur is ke kapde pakad kar kehne lage dushman-e-Khuda baith ja toh ab yeh kehne ka munh nahi rakhta tune jo kuch kiya woh kisi se makhfi nahi ab to is ka ahal nahi ke zubaan mein jo jee mein aaye bak de, yeh naraaz ho kar logon ki gardanein phalangta hua bahar nikal gaya aur kehta jata tha ke goya main kisi badi baat ke kehne ke liye khada hua tha main toh is ka kaam aur mazboot karne ke liye khada hua tha jo chand ashab mujh par uchhal kar aa gaye mujhe ghasitne lage aur dant-dapat karne lage goya ke main kisi badi baat ke kehne ke liye khada hua tha halankeh meri niyat yeh thi ke main aap ki baaton ki taayid karun. Unhon ne kaha khair ab tum wapas chalo hum Rasool Allah ﷺ se arz karenge aap tumhare liye Allah se bakhshish chahenge us ne kaha mujhe koi zaroorat nahi.

Hazrat Qatada aur Hazrat Suddi farmate hain ke yeh aayat Abdullah bin Ubayy ke bare mein utri hai, waqya yeh tha ke isi ki qaum ke ek naujawan musalman ne is ki aisi hi chand buri baatein Rasool Allah ﷺ tak pahunchai thin, Huzoor ﷺ ne bulwaya toh yeh saaf inkaar kar gaya aur qasmein kha gaya, ansariyon ne sahabi ko malamat aur dant-dapat ki aur use jhoota samjha is par yeh aayetein utrin aur is munafiq ki jhooti qasmon aur us naujawan sahabi ki sachai ka Allah Ta'ala ne bayan farmaya, ab is se kaha gaya ke tu chal aur Rasool Allah ﷺ se istighfar kara toh is ne inkaar ke lehje mein sar hila diya aur na gaya.

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke jis manzil mein utarte wahan se koch na karte jab tak namaz na padh lein, Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein Huzoor ﷺ ko khabar pahunchi ke Abdullah bin Ubayy keh raha hai ke hum izzat wale in zillat walon ko Madina pahunch kar nikal denge, pas aap ne aakhri din mein utarne se pehle hi koch kar diya, is se kaha gaya ke Huzoor ﷺ ke paas ja kar apni khata ki muafiyi Allah se talab kar, is ka bayan is aayat mein hai. Is ki asnad Saeed bin Jubair tak sahih hai lekin yeh kehna ke yeh waqya Ghazwa-e-Tabuk ka hai is mein nazar hai balkeh yeh theek nahi hai is liye ke Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul toh is ghazwa mein tha hi nahi balkeh lashkar ki ek jamaat ko le kar yeh toh laut gaya tha. Kutab-e-Sairo-Maghazi ke musannifein mein toh yeh mashhoor hai ke yeh waqya Ghazwa-e-Marisi'a yani Ghazwa-e-Banu Al-Mustaliq ka hai, chunanche is qissa mein Hazrat Muhammad bin Yahya bin Habban aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Abu Bakr aur Hazrat Asim bin Umar bin Qatada se marwi hai ke is ladai ke mauqa par Huzoor ﷺ ka ek jagah qiyam tha, wahan Hazrat Jahjah bin Saeed Al-Ghafari aur Hazrat Sinan bin Yazeed ka pani ke izdiham par kuch jhagda ho gaya, Jahjah Hazrat Umar ke karande thay, jhagde ne tool pakda, Sinan ne ansariyon ko apni madad ke liye aawaz di aur Jahjah ne muhajireen ko. Us waqt Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam waghera ansari ki ek jamaat Abdullah bin Ubayy ke paas baithi hui thi, us ne jab yeh faryad suni toh kehne laga lo hamare hi shahron mein in logon ne hum par hamle shuru kar diye, Allah ki qasam hamari aur in Quraish ki misal wahi hai jo kisi ne kaha hai ke apne kutte ko mota taza kar ke tujhe hi kaate, Allah ki qasam agar hum laut kar Madina gaye toh hum zi-maqdoor log in be-maqdoron ko wahan se nikal denge. Phir is ki qaum ke jo log is ke paas baithe thay un se kehne laga yeh sab aafat tum ne khud apne haathon apne upar li hai tum ne unhein apne shahar mein basaya tum ne unhein apne maal aadhoon aadh hisse diye ab bhi agar tum in ki mali madad na karo toh yeh khud tang aa kar Madina se nikal bhagenge. 

Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam R.A ne yeh tamam baatein sunin aap us waqt bohat kam umr thay seedhe Sarkar-e-Nubuwwat mein hazir hue aur kul waqya bayan farmaya, us waqt aap ke paas Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A bhi baithe hue thay ghazabnak ho kar farmane lage ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Abad bin Bashir ko hukum farmayiye ke is ki gardan alag kar de. Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya phir toh logon mein yeh mashhoor ho jayega ke Muhammad ﷺ apne sathiyon ki gardanein marte hain yeh theek nahi jao logon mein koch ki munadi kar do. Abdullah bin Ubayy ko jab yeh maloom hua ke is ki guftagu ka ilm Anhadrat ﷺ ko ho gaya toh bohat sat-pataya aur Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar uzr-o-ma'azrat aur heelay hawale taweel aur tehreef karne laga aur qasmein kha gaya ke main ne aisa hargiz nahi kaha, chunanche yeh shakhs apni qaum mein zi-izzat aur ba-waqqaat tha aur log bhi kehne lage Huzoor ﷺ shayad is bachche ne hi galti ki ho use wahm ho gaya ho waqya sabit toh hota nahi. Huzoor ﷺ yahan se jaldi hi koch ke waqt se pehle hi tashreef le chale raste mein Hazrat Usayd bin Huzair R.A mile aur aap ke shaan-e-nubuwwat ke qabil ba-adab salam kiya phir arz ki ke Huzoor ﷺ aaj kya baat hai ke waqt se pehle hi janaab ne koch kiya? Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya kya tumhein maloom nahi ke tumhare sathi Ibn Abi ne kya kaha woh kehta hai ke Madina ja kar hum azeez in zaleelon ko nikal denge. Hazrat Usayd ne kaha ya Rasool Allah ﷺ izzat wale aap hain aur zaleel woh hai ya Rasool Allah ﷺ aap is ki in baaton ka khayal bhi na farmayiye darasal yeh bohat jala hua hai suniye Ahl-e-Madina ne ise sardar banane par ittefaq kar liya tha taaj tayyar ho raha tha ke Allah Rabbul Izzat aap ko laya is ke hath se mulk nikal gaya pas yeh chiragh-pa ho raha hai. Huzoor ﷺ chalte rahe, dopahar ko hi chal diye thay shaam hui raat hui subah hui yahan tak ke dhoop mein tezi aa gayi tab aap ne padao kiya taake log is baat mein phir na ulajh jayen, chunanche tamam log thake hare aur raat ke jage hue thay utarte hi sab so gaye idhar yeh soorat nazil hui (Sirat Ibn Ishaq).

Baihaqi mein hai ke hum ek ghazwe mein Huzoor ﷺ ke sath thay ek muhajir ne ek ansari ko patthar maar diya is par baat badh gayi aur donon ne apni apni jamaat se faryad ki aur unhein pukara. Huzoor ﷺ sar-e-naraaz hue aur farmane lage yeh kya jahiliyat ki hank lagane lage is fazool kharab aadat ko chhodo, Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul kehne laga ab muhajir yeh karne lag gaye Allah ki qasam Madina pahunchte hi hum zi-izzat in zaleelon ko wahan se nikal bahar karenge. Us waqt Madina Shareef mein ansariyon ki tadad muhajireen se bohat zyada thi go baad mein muhajireen bohat zyada ho gaye thay. Hazrat Umar ko jab Ibn Abi ke is qaul ka ilm hua toh Huzoor ﷺ se is ke qatl karne ki ijazat chahi magar aap ne rok diya. Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam se marwi hai ke Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein main ne jab is munafiq ka yeh qaul Huzoor ﷺ ke samne bayan kiya aur is ne aa kar inkaar kiya aur qasmein kha gaya us waqt meri qaum ne mujhe bohat kuch bura kaha aur har tarah malamat ki ke main ne aisa kyun kiya?

Main nihayat ghamgeen dil ho kar wahan se chal diya aur sakht ranj-o-gham mein tha ki Huzoor ﷺ ne mujhe yaad farmaya aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne tera uzr nazil farmaya hai aur teri sachchai zahir ki hai aur yeh ayat utri Hum-ul-Lazeena al-kh, yeh hadis aur bhi bahut si kitabon mein hai, Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam ka yeh bayan is tarah hai ki main apne chacha ke sath ek ghazve mein tha aur main ne Abdullah bin Ubay ki yeh dono baten sunin main ne apne chacha se bayan kin aur mere chacha ne Huzoor ﷺ se arz kin jab Aap ne use bulaya us ne inkar kiya aur qasmein kha gayin. Huzoor ﷺ ne use sacha aur mujhe jhoota jana mere chacha ne bhi mujhe bura bhala kaha mujhe is qadar gham aur nadamat hui ki main ne ghar se bahar nikalna chhod diya yahan tak ki yeh surat utri aur Aap ne meri tasdeeq ki aur mujhe yeh padh sunai. Rasulullah ﷺ ne jab unhein is liye bulaya ki Aap un ke liye istighfar karein toh unhein ne us se bhi munh pher liya, Quran-e-Kareem ne unhein tek lagai hui lakdiyan is liye kaha hai ki yeh log achche jameel jism wale thay, Tirmizi waghaira mein Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam R.H se riwayat hai ki hum ek ghazve mein Huzoor ﷺ ke sath nikle hamare sath kuch A'rab log bhi thay pani ki jagah woh pehle pahunchna chahte thay isi tarah hum bhi isi ki koshish mein rehte thay ek martaba ek A'rabi ne ja kar pani par qabza kar ke hoz par kar liya aur us ke ird-gird patthar rakh diye aur upar se chamda phaila diya ek Ansari ne aa kar us hoz mein se apne oont ko pani pilana chaha us ne roka Ansari ne pilane par zor diya us ne ek lakdi utha kar Ansari ke sar par mari jis se us ka sar zakhmi ho gaya. Yeh chukeh Abdullah bin Ubay ka sathi tha seedha us ke paas aya aur tamam majra keh sunaya Abdullah bahut bigda aur kehne laga in A'rabiyon ko kuch na do yeh khud bhookhe marte bhag jayenge, yeh A'rabi khane ki quwwat Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aa jate thay aur kha liya karte thay toh Abdullah bin Ubay ne kaha tum Rasulullah ﷺ ka khana le kar aise waqt jao jab yeh log na hon Aap apne sathiyon ke sath kha lenge yeh reh jayenge yunhi bhookhon marte bhag jayenge aur ab hum Madina ja kar in kamino ko nikal bahar karenge, main us waqt Rasulullah ﷺ ka radeef tha aur main ne yeh sab suna apne chacha se zikr kiya chacha ne Huzoor ﷺ se zikr kiya Aap ne use bulaya yeh inkar kar gaya aur half utha liya Huzoor ﷺ ne use sacha samjha aur mujhe jhoota qarar diya mere chacha mere paas aaye aur kaha tum ne yeh kya harkat ki?

Huzoor ﷺ tujh par naraz ho gaye aur tujhe jhootha jana aur digar musalmanon ne bhi tujhe jhootha samjha, mujh par gham ka pahad toot pada, sakht gham-o-andoh ki halat mein sar jhukaye main Huzoor ﷺ ke sath ja raha tha. Thodi hi der guzri hogi ke aap mere paas aaye, mera kaan pakda, jab main ne sar utha kar aap ki taraf dekha to aap muskuraye aur chal diye, Allah ki qasam mujhe is qadar khushi hui ke bayan se bahar hai, agar duniya ki abadi zindagi mujhe mil jati jab bhi main itna khush na ho sakta tha. Phir Hazrat Siddique Akbar R.A mere paas aaye aur poocha ke An-Hazrat ﷺ ne tum se kya kaha? Main ne kaha: farmaya to kuch bhi nahi, muskurate huye tashreef le gaye. Aap ne farmaya: bas phir khush ho. Aap ke baad hi Hazrat Umar Farooq ؓ tashreef laye, yehi sawal mujh se kiya aur main ne yehi jawab diya. Subah ko Surah Munafiqun nazil hui. 

Dusri riwayat mein is surat ka Min-ha-azzil tak padhna bhi marwi hai, Abdullah bin Lahee'ah aur Musa bin Uqbah ne bhi isi hadith ko Maghazi mein bayan kiya hai lekin un donon ki riwayat mein khabar pahunchane wale ka naam Aus bin Aqram hai jo qabeela Bani Harith bin Khazraj mein se thay. Mumkin hai ke Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam ne bhi khabar pahunchai ho aur Hazrat Aus ne bhi, aur ye bhi mumkin hai ke rawi se naam mein ghalti ho gayi ho, Wallahu A'lam. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke yeh waqia Ghazwa-e-Muraisi' ka hai, yeh woh ghazwa hai jis mein Hazrat Khalid R.A ko bhej kar Huzoor ﷺ ne Manat بت ko tudwaya tha jo Qafa Masal aur samandar ke darmiyan tha. Isi ghazwa mein do shakhson ke darmiyan jhagda ho gaya tha, ek Muhajir tha dusra qabeela Bahz ka tha aur qabeela Bahz Ansarion ka haleef tha. Bahzi ne Ansarion ko aur Muhajir ne Muhajireen ko aawaz di, kuch log donon taraf khade ho gaye aur jhagda hone laga. Jab khatam hua to munafiq aur bimar dil log Abdullah bin Ubayy ke paas jama hue aur kehne lage: humein to tum se bahut kuch ummeedein thin, tum hamare dushmanon se hamara bachao thay, ab to bekaar ho gaye ho, nafa ka khayal na nuqsan ka, tum ne hi in jalaleeb ko itna chadha diya ke baat baat par yeh hum par chadh daudein. Naye Muhajireen ko yeh log jalaleeb kehte thay. 

Is dushman-e-Allah ne jawab diya ke ab Madine pahunchte hi in sab ko wahan se des nikala de denge. Malik bin Dukhshun jo munafiq tha us ne kaha: main to tumhe pehle hi se kehta hoon ke in logon ke sath salook karna chhod do, khud-ba-khud muntashir ho jayenge. Yeh baatein Hazrat Umar R.A ne sun leen aur khidmat-e-Nabawi mein aa kar arz karne lage ke is bani-e-fitna Abdullah bin Ubayy ka qissa paak karne ki mujhe ijazat dijiye. Aap ne farmaya: acha, agar ijazat doon toh kya tum ise qatal kar daaloge?

Hazrat Umar ne kaha Ya Rasulullah ﷺ Allah ki kasam abhi apne haath se iski gardan maarunga, Aap ne farmaya acha baith jaao itne mein Hazrat Usaid bin Huzair bhi yahi kehte hue aaye, Aap ne unse bhi yahi poocha aur unhone bhi yahi jawab diya, Aap ne unhe bhi bitha liya, Phir thodi der guzri hogi ke kooch karne ka hukum diya aur waqt se pehle hi lashkar ne kooch kiya, Woh din raat dusri subah barabar chalte hi rahe jab dhoop mein tezi aa gayi, utarne ko farmaya, Phir dopahar dhalte hi jaldi se kooch kiya aur isi tarah chalte rahe teesre din subah ko Qafa-e-Masal se Madina Sharif pahunch gaye, Hazrat Umar ko bulwaya, Unse poocha ke kya main iske qatal ka tujhe hukum deta toh tu ise maar daalta? Hazrat Umar ne arz kiya yaqeenan main iska sar tan se juda kar deta. Aap ne farmaya agar tu ise us din qatal kar daalta toh bahut se logo ke naak khaak alooda ho jaate, Main agar unhe kehta toh woh bhi ise maar daalne mein taammul na karte, Phir logo ko baatein banane ka mauqa milta ke Muhammad ﷺ apne sathiyein ko bhi bedardi ke sath maar daalta hai, Isi waqt ka bayaan in aayaton mein hai, Yeh siyaq bahut ghareeb hai aur ismein bahut si aisi umda baatein hain jo dusri rivayaton mein nahi, Sirat Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke Abdullah bin Ubayy munafiq ke bete Hazrat Abdullah R.A jo pake sache musalman the is waqe ke baad An-Hazrat ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur guzarish ki ke Ya Rasulullah ﷺ maine suna hai ke mere baap ne jo bakwaas ki hai uske badle aap ise qatal karna chahte hain, Agar yuhin hai toh iske qatal ka hukum aap kisi aur ko na kijiye, Main khud jaata hoon aur abhi iska sar aap ke kadmo tale daalta hoon, Qasam Allah ki qabila Khazraj ka ek ek shakhs jaanta hai ke mujhse zyada koi beta apne baap se ehsan-o-suluk aur mohabbat-o-izzat karne wala nahi (lekin main Farman-e-Rasul ﷺ par apne pyare baap ki gardan maarne ko taiyar hoon), Agar aap ne kisi aur ko yeh hukum diya aur usne ise maara toh mujhe dhar hai ke kahin josh-e-inteqam mein main ise na maar baithun aur zahir hai ke agar yeh harkat mujhse ho gayi toh main ek kafir ke badle ek musalman ko maar kar jahannami ban jaaunga, Aap mere baap ke qatal ka hukum dijiye, Aap ne farmaya nahi nahi main ise qatal karna nahi chahta, Hum toh isse aur narmi bartenge aur iske sath husn-o-suluk karenge jab tak woh hamare sath hai, Hazrat Ikrimah aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Zaid ka bayaan hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ apne lashkaro samet Madine pahunche toh is munafiq Abdullah bin Ubayy ke ladke Hazrat Abdullah R.A Madina Sharif ke darwaze par khade ho gaye, Talwaar khench li, Log Madina mein dakhil hone lage yahan tak ke unka baap aaya toh yeh farmane lage pare raho, Madina mein na jaao, Usne kaha kya baat hai? Mujhe kyun rok raha hai?

Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne farmaya tu Madina mein nahi ja sakta jab tak ke Allah ke Rasool ﷺ tere liye ijazat na dein, izzat wale aap hi hain aur tu zaleel hai, yeh ruk kar khada ho gaya yahan tak ke Rasool Kareem ﷺ tashreef laye aap ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke lashkar ke aakhiri hisse mein hote thay aap ko dekh kar us munafiq ne apne bete ki shikayat ki aap ne un se pucha ke ise kyun rok rakha hai? Unhone kaha qasam hai Allah ki jab tak aap ki ijazat na ho yeh andar nahi ja sakta chunacha Huzoor ﷺ ne ijazat di ab Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne apne baap ko shehar mein dakhil hone diya, Musnad Humaidi mein hai ke aap ne apne walid se kaha jab tak tu apni zaban se yeh na kahe ke Rasool Allah ﷺ عزت wale aur main zaleel to Madina mein nahi ja sakta aur is se pehle Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar arz kiya tha ke ya Rasool Allah ﷺ apne baap ki haibat ki wajah se main ne aaj tak nigaah oonchi kar ke un ke chehre ko bhi nahi dekha lekin aap agar is par naraz hain toh mujhe hukum dijiye abhi is ki gardan hazir karta hoon kisi aur ko is ke qatal ka hukum na dijiye aisa na ho ke main apne baap ke qatal ko apni aankhon se chalta phirta na dekh sakoon.

Munafiqon ki mahrumi-e-saadat ke asbab mal'un munafiqon ka zikr ho raha hai ke unke gunahon par jab unse sachche musalman kehte hain ke aao Rasul-e-Karim (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tumhare liye istighfar karenge toh Allah Ta'ala tumhare gunah maaf farma dega toh yeh takabbur ke sath sar hilane lagte hain aur i'raz karte hain aur ruk jate hain aur is baat ko haqarat ke sath radd kar dete hain, iska badla yahi hai ke ab unke liye bakhshish ke darwaze band hain Nabi ka istighfar bhi unhe kuch nafa na dega, bhala in fasiqon ki qismat mein hidayat kahan?

Surah Bara'at mein bhi isi mazmoon ki aayat guzar chuki hai aur wahin iski tafsir aur sath hi iske mutaliq ki hadeethein bhi bayan kar di gayi hain, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Sufyan rawi ne apna munh dayen janib pher liya tha aur ghazab-o-takabbur ke sath tirchi aankh se ghoor kar dikhaya tha isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai aur salaf mein se aksar hazraat ka farman hai ke yeh sab ka sab bayan Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul ka hai jaise ke anqareeb aa raha hai Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Sirat Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul apni qaum ka bada aur shareef shakhs tha jab Nabi ﷺ jumma ke din khutbah ke liye mimar par baithte thay toh yeh khada ho jata tha aur kehta tha logon yeh hain Allah ke Rasool ﷺ jo tum mein maujood hain jin ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala ne tumhara ikram kiya aur tumhein izrat di ab tum par farz hai ke tum aap ki madad karo aur aap ki izzat-o-takreem karo aap ka farman suno aur jo farmayein baja lao yeh keh kar baith jaya karta tha. Uhud ke maidan mein is ka nifaq khul gaya aur yeh wahan se Huzoor ﷺ ki khuli nafarmani kar ke tihai lashkar ko le kar Madina ko wapas laut aaya jab Rasool Allah ﷺ Ghazwa-e-Uhud se farigh hue aur Madina mein ma-l-khair tashreef laye jumma ka din aaya aur aap mimar par chadhe toh hasab-e-aadat yeh aaj bhi khada hua aur kehna chahta hi tha ke ba'az sahaba idhar udhar se khade ho gaye aur is ke kapde pakad kar kehne lage dushman-e-Khuda baith ja toh ab yeh kehne ka munh nahi rakhta tune jo kuch kiya woh kisi se makhfi nahi ab to is ka ahal nahi ke zubaan mein jo jee mein aaye bak de, yeh naraaz ho kar logon ki gardanein phalangta hua bahar nikal gaya aur kehta jata tha ke goya main kisi badi baat ke kehne ke liye khada hua tha main toh is ka kaam aur mazboot karne ke liye khada hua tha jo chand ashab mujh par uchhal kar aa gaye mujhe ghasitne lage aur dant-dapat karne lage goya ke main kisi badi baat ke kehne ke liye khada hua tha halankeh meri niyat yeh thi ke main aap ki baaton ki taayid karun. Unhon ne kaha khair ab tum wapas chalo hum Rasool Allah ﷺ se arz karenge aap tumhare liye Allah se bakhshish chahenge us ne kaha mujhe koi zaroorat nahi.

Hazrat Qatada aur Hazrat Suddi farmate hain ke yeh aayat Abdullah bin Ubayy ke bare mein utri hai, waqya yeh tha ke isi ki qaum ke ek naujawan musalman ne is ki aisi hi chand buri baatein Rasool Allah ﷺ tak pahunchai thin, Huzoor ﷺ ne bulwaya toh yeh saaf inkaar kar gaya aur qasmein kha gaya, ansariyon ne sahabi ko malamat aur dant-dapat ki aur use jhoota samjha is par yeh aayetein utrin aur is munafiq ki jhooti qasmon aur us naujawan sahabi ki sachai ka Allah Ta'ala ne bayan farmaya, ab is se kaha gaya ke tu chal aur Rasool Allah ﷺ se istighfar kara toh is ne inkaar ke lehje mein sar hila diya aur na gaya.

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke jis manzil mein utarte wahan se koch na karte jab tak namaz na padh lein, Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein Huzoor ﷺ ko khabar pahunchi ke Abdullah bin Ubayy keh raha hai ke hum izzat wale in zillat walon ko Madina pahunch kar nikal denge, pas aap ne aakhri din mein utarne se pehle hi koch kar diya, is se kaha gaya ke Huzoor ﷺ ke paas ja kar apni khata ki muafiyi Allah se talab kar, is ka bayan is aayat mein hai. Is ki asnad Saeed bin Jubair tak sahih hai lekin yeh kehna ke yeh waqya Ghazwa-e-Tabuk ka hai is mein nazar hai balkeh yeh theek nahi hai is liye ke Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul toh is ghazwa mein tha hi nahi balkeh lashkar ki ek jamaat ko le kar yeh toh laut gaya tha. Kutab-e-Sairo-Maghazi ke musannifein mein toh yeh mashhoor hai ke yeh waqya Ghazwa-e-Marisi'a yani Ghazwa-e-Banu Al-Mustaliq ka hai, chunanche is qissa mein Hazrat Muhammad bin Yahya bin Habban aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Abu Bakr aur Hazrat Asim bin Umar bin Qatada se marwi hai ke is ladai ke mauqa par Huzoor ﷺ ka ek jagah qiyam tha, wahan Hazrat Jahjah bin Saeed Al-Ghafari aur Hazrat Sinan bin Yazeed ka pani ke izdiham par kuch jhagda ho gaya, Jahjah Hazrat Umar ke karande thay, jhagde ne tool pakda, Sinan ne ansariyon ko apni madad ke liye aawaz di aur Jahjah ne muhajireen ko. Us waqt Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam waghera ansari ki ek jamaat Abdullah bin Ubayy ke paas baithi hui thi, us ne jab yeh faryad suni toh kehne laga lo hamare hi shahron mein in logon ne hum par hamle shuru kar diye, Allah ki qasam hamari aur in Quraish ki misal wahi hai jo kisi ne kaha hai ke apne kutte ko mota taza kar ke tujhe hi kaate, Allah ki qasam agar hum laut kar Madina gaye toh hum zi-maqdoor log in be-maqdoron ko wahan se nikal denge. Phir is ki qaum ke jo log is ke paas baithe thay un se kehne laga yeh sab aafat tum ne khud apne haathon apne upar li hai tum ne unhein apne shahar mein basaya tum ne unhein apne maal aadhoon aadh hisse diye ab bhi agar tum in ki mali madad na karo toh yeh khud tang aa kar Madina se nikal bhagenge. 

Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam R.A ne yeh tamam baatein sunin aap us waqt bohat kam umr thay seedhe Sarkar-e-Nubuwwat mein hazir hue aur kul waqya bayan farmaya, us waqt aap ke paas Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A bhi baithe hue thay ghazabnak ho kar farmane lage ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Abad bin Bashir ko hukum farmayiye ke is ki gardan alag kar de. Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya phir toh logon mein yeh mashhoor ho jayega ke Muhammad ﷺ apne sathiyon ki gardanein marte hain yeh theek nahi jao logon mein koch ki munadi kar do. Abdullah bin Ubayy ko jab yeh maloom hua ke is ki guftagu ka ilm Anhadrat ﷺ ko ho gaya toh bohat sat-pataya aur Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar uzr-o-ma'azrat aur heelay hawale taweel aur tehreef karne laga aur qasmein kha gaya ke main ne aisa hargiz nahi kaha, chunanche yeh shakhs apni qaum mein zi-izzat aur ba-waqqaat tha aur log bhi kehne lage Huzoor ﷺ shayad is bachche ne hi galti ki ho use wahm ho gaya ho waqya sabit toh hota nahi. Huzoor ﷺ yahan se jaldi hi koch ke waqt se pehle hi tashreef le chale raste mein Hazrat Usayd bin Huzair R.A mile aur aap ke shaan-e-nubuwwat ke qabil ba-adab salam kiya phir arz ki ke Huzoor ﷺ aaj kya baat hai ke waqt se pehle hi janaab ne koch kiya? Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya kya tumhein maloom nahi ke tumhare sathi Ibn Abi ne kya kaha woh kehta hai ke Madina ja kar hum azeez in zaleelon ko nikal denge. Hazrat Usayd ne kaha ya Rasool Allah ﷺ izzat wale aap hain aur zaleel woh hai ya Rasool Allah ﷺ aap is ki in baaton ka khayal bhi na farmayiye darasal yeh bohat jala hua hai suniye Ahl-e-Madina ne ise sardar banane par ittefaq kar liya tha taaj tayyar ho raha tha ke Allah Rabbul Izzat aap ko laya is ke hath se mulk nikal gaya pas yeh chiragh-pa ho raha hai. Huzoor ﷺ chalte rahe, dopahar ko hi chal diye thay shaam hui raat hui subah hui yahan tak ke dhoop mein tezi aa gayi tab aap ne padao kiya taake log is baat mein phir na ulajh jayen, chunanche tamam log thake hare aur raat ke jage hue thay utarte hi sab so gaye idhar yeh soorat nazil hui (Sirat Ibn Ishaq).

Baihaqi mein hai ke hum ek ghazwe mein Huzoor ﷺ ke sath thay ek muhajir ne ek ansari ko patthar maar diya is par baat badh gayi aur donon ne apni apni jamaat se faryad ki aur unhein pukara. Huzoor ﷺ sar-e-naraaz hue aur farmane lage yeh kya jahiliyat ki hank lagane lage is fazool kharab aadat ko chhodo, Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul kehne laga ab muhajir yeh karne lag gaye Allah ki qasam Madina pahunchte hi hum zi-izzat in zaleelon ko wahan se nikal bahar karenge. Us waqt Madina Shareef mein ansariyon ki tadad muhajireen se bohat zyada thi go baad mein muhajireen bohat zyada ho gaye thay. Hazrat Umar ko jab Ibn Abi ke is qaul ka ilm hua toh Huzoor ﷺ se is ke qatl karne ki ijazat chahi magar aap ne rok diya. Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam se marwi hai ke Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein main ne jab is munafiq ka yeh qaul Huzoor ﷺ ke samne bayan kiya aur is ne aa kar inkaar kiya aur qasmein kha gaya us waqt meri qaum ne mujhe bohat kuch bura kaha aur har tarah malamat ki ke main ne aisa kyun kiya?

Main nihayat ghamgeen dil ho kar wahan se chal diya aur sakht ranj-o-gham mein tha ki Huzoor ﷺ ne mujhe yaad farmaya aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne tera uzr nazil farmaya hai aur teri sachchai zahir ki hai aur yeh ayat utri Hum-ul-Lazeena al-kh, yeh hadis aur bhi bahut si kitabon mein hai, Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam ka yeh bayan is tarah hai ki main apne chacha ke sath ek ghazve mein tha aur main ne Abdullah bin Ubay ki yeh dono baten sunin main ne apne chacha se bayan kin aur mere chacha ne Huzoor ﷺ se arz kin jab Aap ne use bulaya us ne inkar kiya aur qasmein kha gayin. Huzoor ﷺ ne use sacha aur mujhe jhoota jana mere chacha ne bhi mujhe bura bhala kaha mujhe is qadar gham aur nadamat hui ki main ne ghar se bahar nikalna chhod diya yahan tak ki yeh surat utri aur Aap ne meri tasdeeq ki aur mujhe yeh padh sunai. Musnad ki aur riwayat mein hai ki ek safar ke mauqe par jab Sahaba ko tangi pahunchi toh us ne unhein kuch dene ki momanat kar di. Rasulullah ﷺ ne jab unhein is liye bulaya ki Aap un ke liye istighfar karein toh unhein ne us se bhi munh pher liya, Quran-e-Kareem ne unhein tek lagai hui lakdiyan is liye kaha hai ki yeh log achche jameel jism wale thay, Tirmizi waghaira mein Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam R.H se riwayat hai ki hum ek ghazve mein Huzoor ﷺ ke sath nikle hamare sath kuch A'rab log bhi thay pani ki jagah woh pehle pahunchna chahte thay isi tarah hum bhi isi ki koshish mein rehte thay ek martaba ek A'rabi ne ja kar pani par qabza kar ke hoz par kar liya aur us ke ird-gird patthar rakh diye aur upar se chamda phaila diya ek Ansari ne aa kar us hoz mein se apne oont ko pani pilana chaha us ne roka Ansari ne pilane par zor diya us ne ek lakdi utha kar Ansari ke sar par mari jis se us ka sar zakhmi ho gaya. Yeh chukeh Abdullah bin Ubay ka sathi tha seedha us ke paas aya aur tamam majra keh sunaya Abdullah bahut bigda aur kehne laga in A'rabiyon ko kuch na do yeh khud bhookhe marte bhag jayenge, yeh A'rabi khane ki quwwat Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aa jate thay aur kha liya karte thay toh Abdullah bin Ubay ne kaha tum Rasulullah ﷺ ka khana le kar aise waqt jao jab yeh log na hon Aap apne sathiyon ke sath kha lenge yeh reh jayenge yunhi bhookhon marte bhag jayenge aur ab hum Madina ja kar in kamino ko nikal bahar karenge, main us waqt Rasulullah ﷺ ka radeef tha aur main ne yeh sab suna apne chacha se zikr kiya chacha ne Huzoor ﷺ se zikr kiya Aap ne use bulaya yeh inkar kar gaya aur half utha liya Huzoor ﷺ ne use sacha samjha aur mujhe jhoota qarar diya mere chacha mere paas aaye aur kaha tum ne yeh kya harkat ki?

Huzoor ﷺ tujh par naraz ho gaye aur tujhe jhootha jana aur digar musalmanon ne bhi tujhe jhootha samjha, mujh par gham ka pahad toot pada, sakht gham-o-andoh ki halat mein sar jhukaye main Huzoor ﷺ ke sath ja raha tha. Dusri riwayat mein is surat ka Min-ha-azzil tak padhna bhi marwi hai, Abdullah bin Lahee'ah aur Musa bin Uqbah ne bhi isi hadith ko Maghazi mein bayan kiya hai lekin un donon ki riwayat mein khabar pahunchane wale ka naam Aus bin Aqram hai jo qabeela Bani Harith bin Khazraj mein se thay. Mumkin hai ke Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam ne bhi khabar pahunchai ho aur Hazrat Aus ne bhi, aur ye bhi mumkin hai ke rawi se naam mein ghalti ho gayi ho, Wallahu A'lam. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke yeh waqia Ghazwa-e-Muraisi' ka hai, yeh woh ghazwa hai jis mein Hazrat Khalid R.A ko bhej kar Huzoor ﷺ ne Manat بت ko tudwaya tha jo Qafa Masal aur samandar ke darmiyan tha. Isi ghazwa mein do shakhson ke darmiyan jhagda ho gaya tha, ek Muhajir tha dusra qabeela Bahz ka tha aur qabeela Bahz Ansarion ka haleef tha. Bahzi ne Ansarion ko aur Muhajir ne Muhajireen ko aawaz di, kuch log donon taraf khade ho gaye aur jhagda hone laga. Jab khatam hua to munafiq aur bimar dil log Abdullah bin Ubayy ke paas jama hue aur kehne lage: humein to tum se bahut kuch ummeedein thin, tum hamare dushmanon se hamara bachao thay, ab to bekaar ho gaye ho, nafa ka khayal na nuqsan ka, tum ne hi in jalaleeb ko itna chadha diya ke baat baat par yeh hum par chadh daudein. Naye Muhajireen ko yeh log jalaleeb kehte thay. 

Is dushman-e-Allah ne jawab diya ke ab Madine pahunchte hi in sab ko wahan se des nikala de denge. Malik bin Dukhshun jo munafiq tha us ne kaha: main to tumhe pehle hi se kehta hoon ke in logon ke sath salook karna chhod do, khud-ba-khud muntashir ho jayenge. Yeh baatein Hazrat Umar R.A ne sun leen aur khidmat-e-Nabawi mein aa kar arz karne lage ke is bani-e-fitna Abdullah bin Ubayy ka qissa paak karne ki mujhe ijazat dijiye. Aap ne farmaya: acha, agar ijazat doon toh kya tum ise qatal kar daaloge?

Hazrat Umar ne kaha Ya Rasulullah ﷺ Allah ki kasam abhi apne haath se iski gardan maarunga, Aap ne farmaya acha baith jaao itne mein Hazrat Usaid bin Huzair bhi yahi kehte hue aaye, Aap ne unse bhi yahi poocha aur unhone bhi yahi jawab diya, Aap ne unhe bhi bitha liya, Phir thodi der guzri hogi ke kooch karne ka hukum diya aur waqt se pehle hi lashkar ne kooch kiya, Woh din raat dusri subah barabar chalte hi rahe jab dhoop mein tezi aa gayi, utarne ko farmaya, Phir dopahar dhalte hi jaldi se kooch kiya aur isi tarah chalte rahe teesre din subah ko Qafa-e-Masal se Madina Sharif pahunch gaye, Hazrat Umar ko bulwaya, Unse poocha ke kya main iske qatal ka tujhe hukum deta toh tu ise maar daalta? Hazrat Umar ne arz kiya yaqeenan main iska sar tan se juda kar deta. Aap ne farmaya agar tu ise us din qatal kar daalta toh bahut se logo ke naak khaak alooda ho jaate, Main agar unhe kehta toh woh bhi ise maar daalne mein taammul na karte, Phir logo ko baatein banane ka mauqa milta ke Muhammad ﷺ apne sathiyein ko bhi bedardi ke sath maar daalta hai, Isi waqt ka bayaan in aayaton mein hai, Yeh siyaq bahut ghareeb hai aur ismein bahut si aisi umda baatein hain jo dusri rivayaton mein nahi, Sirat Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke Abdullah bin Ubayy munafiq ke bete Hazrat Abdullah R.A jo pake sache musalman the is waqe ke baad An-Hazrat ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur guzarish ki ke Ya Rasulullah ﷺ maine suna hai ke mere baap ne jo bakwaas ki hai uske badle aap ise qatal karna chahte hain, Agar yuhin hai toh iske qatal ka hukum aap kisi aur ko na kijiye, Main khud jaata hoon aur abhi iska sar aap ke kadmo tale daalta hoon, Qasam Allah ki qabila Khazraj ka ek ek shakhs jaanta hai ke mujhse zyada koi beta apne baap se ehsan-o-suluk aur mohabbat-o-izzat karne wala nahi (lekin main Farman-e-Rasul ﷺ par apne pyare baap ki gardan maarne ko taiyar hoon), Agar aap ne kisi aur ko yeh hukum diya aur usne ise maara toh mujhe dhar hai ke kahin josh-e-inteqam mein main ise na maar baithun aur zahir hai ke agar yeh harkat mujhse ho gayi toh main ek kafir ke badle ek musalman ko maar kar jahannami ban jaaunga, Aap mere baap ke qatal ka hukum dijiye, Aap ne farmaya nahi nahi main ise qatal karna nahi chahta, Hum toh isse aur narmi bartenge aur iske sath husn-o-suluk karenge jab tak woh hamare sath hai, Hazrat Ikrimah aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Zaid ka bayaan hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ apne lashkaro samet Madine pahunche toh is munafiq Abdullah bin Ubayy ke ladke Hazrat Abdullah R.A Madina Sharif ke darwaze par khade ho gaye, Talwaar khench li, Log Madina mein dakhil hone lage yahan tak ke unka baap aaya toh yeh farmane lage pare raho, Madina mein na jaao, Usne kaha kya baat hai? Mujhe kyun rok raha hai?

Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne farmaya tu Madina mein nahi ja sakta jab tak ke Allah ke Rasool ﷺ tere liye ijazat na dein, izzat wale aap hi hain aur tu zaleel hai, yeh ruk kar khada ho gaya yahan tak ke Rasool Kareem ﷺ tashreef laye aap ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke lashkar ke aakhiri hisse mein hote thay aap ko dekh kar us munafiq ne apne bete ki shikayat ki aap ne un se pucha ke ise kyun rok rakha hai? Unhone kaha qasam hai Allah ki jab tak aap ki ijazat na ho yeh andar nahi ja sakta chunacha Huzoor ﷺ ne ijazat di ab Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne apne baap ko shehar mein dakhil hone diya, Musnad Humaidi mein hai ke aap ne apne walid se kaha jab tak tu apni zaban se yeh na kahe ke Rasool Allah ﷺ عزت wale aur main zaleel to Madina mein nahi ja sakta aur is se pehle Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar arz kiya tha ke ya Rasool Allah ﷺ apne baap ki haibat ki wajah se main ne aaj tak nigaah oonchi kar ke un ke chehre ko bhi nahi dekha lekin aap agar is par naraz hain toh mujhe hukum dijiye abhi is ki gardan hazir karta hoon kisi aur ko is ke qatal ka hukum na dijiye aisa na ho ke main apne baap ke qatal ko apni aankhon se chalta phirta na dekh sakoon.

Munafiqon ki mahrumi-e-saadat ke asbab mal'un munafiqon ka zikr ho raha hai ke unke gunahon par jab unse sachche musalman kehte hain ke aao Rasul-e-Karim (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tumhare liye istighfar karenge toh Allah Ta'ala tumhare gunah maaf farma dega toh yeh takabbur ke sath sar hilane lagte hain aur i'raz karte hain aur ruk jate hain aur is baat ko haqarat ke sath radd kar dete hain, iska badla yahi hai ke ab unke liye bakhshish ke darwaze band hain Nabi ka istighfar bhi unhe kuch nafa na dega, bhala in fasiqon ki qismat mein hidayat kahan?

Surah Bara'at mein bhi isi mazmoon ki aayat guzar chuki hai aur wahin iski tafsir aur sath hi iske mutaliq ki hadeethein bhi bayan kar di gayi hain, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Sufyan rawi ne apna munh dayen janib pher liya tha aur ghazab-o-takabbur ke sath tirchi aankh se ghoor kar dikhaya tha isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai aur salaf mein se aksar hazraat ka farman hai ke yeh sab ka sab bayan Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul ka hai jaise ke anqareeb aa raha hai Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Sirat Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul apni qaum ka bada aur shareef shakhs tha jab Nabi ﷺ jumma ke din khutbah ke liye mimar par baithte thay toh yeh khada ho jata tha aur kehta tha logon yeh hain Allah ke Rasool ﷺ jo tum mein maujood hain jin ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala ne tumhara ikram kiya aur tumhein izrat di ab tum par farz hai ke tum aap ki madad karo aur aap ki izzat-o-takreem karo aap ka farman suno aur jo farmayein baja lao yeh keh kar baith jaya karta tha. Uhud ke maidan mein is ka nifaq khul gaya aur yeh wahan se Huzoor ﷺ ki khuli nafarmani kar ke tihai lashkar ko le kar Madina ko wapas laut aaya jab Rasool Allah ﷺ Ghazwa-e-Uhud se farigh hue aur Madina mein ma-l-khair tashreef laye jumma ka din aaya aur aap mimar par chadhe toh hasab-e-aadat yeh aaj bhi khada hua aur kehna chahta hi tha ke ba'az sahaba idhar udhar se khade ho gaye aur is ke kapde pakad kar kehne lage dushman-e-Khuda baith ja toh ab yeh kehne ka munh nahi rakhta tune jo kuch kiya woh kisi se makhfi nahi ab to is ka ahal nahi ke zubaan mein jo jee mein aaye bak de, yeh naraaz ho kar logon ki gardanein phalangta hua bahar nikal gaya aur kehta jata tha ke goya main kisi badi baat ke kehne ke liye khada hua tha main toh is ka kaam aur mazboot karne ke liye khada hua tha jo chand ashab mujh par uchhal kar aa gaye mujhe ghasitne lage aur dant-dapat karne lage goya ke main kisi badi baat ke kehne ke liye khada hua tha halankeh meri niyat yeh thi ke main aap ki baaton ki taayid karun. Unhon ne kaha khair ab tum wapas chalo hum Rasool Allah ﷺ se arz karenge aap tumhare liye Allah se bakhshish chahenge us ne kaha mujhe koi zaroorat nahi.

Hazrat Qatada aur Hazrat Suddi farmate hain ke yeh aayat Abdullah bin Ubayy ke bare mein utri hai, waqya yeh tha ke isi ki qaum ke ek naujawan musalman ne is ki aisi hi chand buri baatein Rasool Allah ﷺ tak pahunchai thin, Huzoor ﷺ ne bulwaya toh yeh saaf inkaar kar gaya aur qasmein kha gaya, ansariyon ne sahabi ko malamat aur dant-dapat ki aur use jhoota samjha is par yeh aayetein utrin aur is munafiq ki jhooti qasmon aur us naujawan sahabi ki sachai ka Allah Ta'ala ne bayan farmaya, ab is se kaha gaya ke tu chal aur Rasool Allah ﷺ se istighfar kara toh is ne inkaar ke lehje mein sar hila diya aur na gaya.

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke jis manzil mein utarte wahan se koch na karte jab tak namaz na padh lein, Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein Huzoor ﷺ ko khabar pahunchi ke Abdullah bin Ubayy keh raha hai ke hum izzat wale in zillat walon ko Madina pahunch kar nikal denge, pas aap ne aakhri din mein utarne se pehle hi koch kar diya, is se kaha gaya ke Huzoor ﷺ ke paas ja kar apni khata ki muafiyi Allah se talab kar, is ka bayan is aayat mein hai. Is ki asnad Saeed bin Jubair tak sahih hai lekin yeh kehna ke yeh waqya Ghazwa-e-Tabuk ka hai is mein nazar hai balkeh yeh theek nahi hai is liye ke Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul toh is ghazwa mein tha hi nahi balkeh lashkar ki ek jamaat ko le kar yeh toh laut gaya tha. Kutab-e-Sairo-Maghazi ke musannifein mein toh yeh mashhoor hai ke yeh waqya Ghazwa-e-Marisi'a yani Ghazwa-e-Banu Al-Mustaliq ka hai, chunanche is qissa mein Hazrat Muhammad bin Yahya bin Habban aur Hazrat Abdullah bin Abu Bakr aur Hazrat Asim bin Umar bin Qatada se marwi hai ke is ladai ke mauqa par Huzoor ﷺ ka ek jagah qiyam tha, wahan Hazrat Jahjah bin Saeed Al-Ghafari aur Hazrat Sinan bin Yazeed ka pani ke izdiham par kuch jhagda ho gaya, Jahjah Hazrat Umar ke karande thay, jhagde ne tool pakda, Sinan ne ansariyon ko apni madad ke liye aawaz di aur Jahjah ne muhajireen ko. Us waqt Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam waghera ansari ki ek jamaat Abdullah bin Ubayy ke paas baithi hui thi, us ne jab yeh faryad suni toh kehne laga lo hamare hi shahron mein in logon ne hum par hamle shuru kar diye, Allah ki qasam hamari aur in Quraish ki misal wahi hai jo kisi ne kaha hai ke apne kutte ko mota taza kar ke tujhe hi kaate, Allah ki qasam agar hum laut kar Madina gaye toh hum zi-maqdoor log in be-maqdoron ko wahan se nikal denge. Phir is ki qaum ke jo log is ke paas baithe thay un se kehne laga yeh sab aafat tum ne khud apne haathon apne upar li hai tum ne unhein apne shahar mein basaya tum ne unhein apne maal aadhoon aadh hisse diye ab bhi agar tum in ki mali madad na karo toh yeh khud tang aa kar Madina se nikal bhagenge. 

Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam R.A ne yeh tamam baatein sunin aap us waqt bohat kam umr thay seedhe Sarkar-e-Nubuwwat mein hazir hue aur kul waqya bayan farmaya, us waqt aap ke paas Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A bhi baithe hue thay ghazabnak ho kar farmane lage ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Abad bin Bashir ko hukum farmayiye ke is ki gardan alag kar de. Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya phir toh logon mein yeh mashhoor ho jayega ke Muhammad ﷺ apne sathiyon ki gardanein marte hain yeh theek nahi jao logon mein koch ki munadi kar do. Abdullah bin Ubayy ko jab yeh maloom hua ke is ki guftagu ka ilm Anhadrat ﷺ ko ho gaya toh bohat sat-pataya aur Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar uzr-o-ma'azrat aur heelay hawale taweel aur tehreef karne laga aur qasmein kha gaya ke main ne aisa hargiz nahi kaha, chunanche yeh shakhs apni qaum mein zi-izzat aur ba-waqqaat tha aur log bhi kehne lage Huzoor ﷺ shayad is bachche ne hi galti ki ho use wahm ho gaya ho waqya sabit toh hota nahi. Huzoor ﷺ yahan se jaldi hi koch ke waqt se pehle hi tashreef le chale raste mein Hazrat Usayd bin Huzair R.A mile aur aap ke shaan-e-nubuwwat ke qabil ba-adab salam kiya phir arz ki ke Huzoor ﷺ aaj kya baat hai ke waqt se pehle hi janaab ne koch kiya? Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya kya tumhein maloom nahi ke tumhare sathi Ibn Abi ne kya kaha woh kehta hai ke Madina ja kar hum azeez in zaleelon ko nikal denge. Hazrat Usayd ne kaha ya Rasool Allah ﷺ izzat wale aap hain aur zaleel woh hai ya Rasool Allah ﷺ aap is ki in baaton ka khayal bhi na farmayiye darasal yeh bohat jala hua hai suniye Ahl-e-Madina ne ise sardar banane par ittefaq kar liya tha taaj tayyar ho raha tha ke Allah Rabbul Izzat aap ko laya is ke hath se mulk nikal gaya pas yeh chiragh-pa ho raha hai. Huzoor ﷺ chalte rahe, dopahar ko hi chal diye thay shaam hui raat hui subah hui yahan tak ke dhoop mein tezi aa gayi tab aap ne padao kiya taake log is baat mein phir na ulajh jayen, chunanche tamam log thake hare aur raat ke jage hue thay utarte hi sab so gaye idhar yeh soorat nazil hui (Sirat Ibn Ishaq).

Baihaqi mein hai ke hum ek ghazwe mein Huzoor ﷺ ke sath thay ek muhajir ne ek ansari ko patthar maar diya is par baat badh gayi aur donon ne apni apni jamaat se faryad ki aur unhein pukara. Huzoor ﷺ sar-e-naraaz hue aur farmane lage yeh kya jahiliyat ki hank lagane lage is fazool kharab aadat ko chhodo, Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salul kehne laga ab muhajir yeh karne lag gaye Allah ki qasam Madina pahunchte hi hum zi-izzat in zaleelon ko wahan se nikal bahar karenge. Us waqt Madina Shareef mein ansariyon ki tadad muhajireen se bohat zyada thi go baad mein muhajireen bohat zyada ho gaye thay. Hazrat Umar ko jab Ibn Abi ke is qaul ka ilm hua toh Huzoor ﷺ se is ke qatl karne ki ijazat chahi magar aap ne rok diya. Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam se marwi hai ke Ghazwa-e-Tabuk mein main ne jab is munafiq ka yeh qaul Huzoor ﷺ ke samne bayan kiya aur is ne aa kar inkaar kiya aur qasmein kha gaya us waqt meri qaum ne mujhe bohat kuch bura kaha aur har tarah malamat ki ke main ne aisa kyun kiya?

Main nihayat ghamgeen dil ho kar wahan se chal diya aur sakht ranj-o-gham mein tha ki Huzoor ﷺ ne mujhe yaad farmaya aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne tera uzr nazil farmaya hai aur teri sachchai zahir ki hai aur yeh ayat utri Hum-ul-Lazeena al-kh, yeh hadis aur bhi bahut si kitabon mein hai, Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam ka yeh bayan is tarah hai ki main apne chacha ke sath ek ghazve mein tha aur main ne Abdullah bin Ubay ki yeh dono baten sunin main ne apne chacha se bayan kin aur mere chacha ne Huzoor ﷺ se arz kin jab Aap ne use bulaya us ne inkar kiya aur qasmein kha gayin. Huzoor ﷺ ne use sacha aur mujhe jhoota jana mere chacha ne bhi mujhe bura bhala kaha mujhe is qadar gham aur nadamat hui ki main ne ghar se bahar nikalna chhod diya yahan tak ki yeh surat utri aur Aap ne meri tasdeeq ki aur mujhe yeh padh sunai. Musnad ki aur riwayat mein hai ki ek safar ke mauqe par jab Sahaba ko tangi pahunchi toh us ne unhein kuch dene ki momanat kar di. Rasulullah ﷺ ne jab unhein is liye bulaya ki Aap un ke liye istighfar karein toh unhein ne us se bhi munh pher liya, Quran-e-Kareem ne unhein tek lagai hui lakdiyan is liye kaha hai ki yeh log achche jameel jism wale thay, Tirmizi waghaira mein Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam R.H se riwayat hai ki hum ek ghazve mein Huzoor ﷺ ke sath nikle hamare sath kuch A'rab log bhi thay pani ki jagah woh pehle pahunchna chahte thay isi tarah hum bhi isi ki koshish mein rehte thay ek martaba ek A'rabi ne ja kar pani par qabza kar ke hoz par kar liya aur us ke ird-gird patthar rakh diye aur upar se chamda phaila diya ek Ansari ne aa kar us hoz mein se apne oont ko pani pilana chaha us ne roka Ansari ne pilane par zor diya us ne ek lakdi utha kar Ansari ke sar par mari jis se us ka sar zakhmi ho gaya. Yeh chukeh Abdullah bin Ubay ka sathi tha seedha us ke paas aya aur tamam majra keh sunaya Abdullah bahut bigda aur kehne laga in A'rabiyon ko kuch na do yeh khud bhookhe marte bhag jayenge, yeh A'rabi khane ki quwwat Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aa jate thay aur kha liya karte thay toh Abdullah bin Ubay ne kaha tum Rasulullah ﷺ ka khana le kar aise waqt jao jab yeh log na hon Aap apne sathiyon ke sath kha lenge yeh reh jayenge yunhi bhookhon marte bhag jayenge aur ab hum Madina ja kar in kamino ko nikal bahar karenge, main us waqt Rasulullah ﷺ ka radeef tha aur main ne yeh sab suna apne chacha se zikr kiya chacha ne Huzoor ﷺ se zikr kiya Aap ne use bulaya yeh inkar kar gaya aur half utha liya Huzoor ﷺ ne use sacha samjha aur mujhe jhoota qarar diya mere chacha mere paas aaye aur kaha tum ne yeh kya harkat ki?

Huzoor ﷺ tujh par naraz ho gaye aur tujhe jhootha jana aur digar musalmanon ne bhi tujhe jhootha samjha, mujh par gham ka pahad toot pada, sakht gham-o-andoh ki halat mein sar jhukaye main Huzoor ﷺ ke sath ja raha tha. Thodi hi der guzri hogi ke aap mere paas aaye, mera kaan pakda, jab main ne sar utha kar aap ki taraf dekha to aap muskuraye aur chal diye, Allah ki qasam mujhe is qadar khushi hui ke bayan se bahar hai, agar duniya ki abadi zindagi mujhe mil jati jab bhi main itna khush na ho sakta tha. Phir Hazrat Siddique Akbar R.A mere paas aaye aur poocha ke An-Hazrat ﷺ ne tum se kya kaha? Main ne kaha: farmaya to kuch bhi nahi, muskurate huye tashreef le gaye. Aap ne farmaya: bas phir khush ho. Aap ke baad hi Hazrat Umar Farooq ؓ tashreef laye, yehi sawal mujh se kiya aur main ne yehi jawab diya. Subah ko Surah Munafiqun nazil hui.

Aap ne farmaya agar tu ise us din qatal kar daalta toh bahut se logo ke naak khaak alooda ho jaate, Main agar unhe kehta toh woh bhi ise maar daalne mein taammul na karte, Phir logo ko baatein banane ka mauqa milta ke Muhammad ﷺ apne sathiyein ko bhi bedardi ke sath maar daalta hai, Isi waqt ka bayaan in aayaton mein hai, Yeh siyaq bahut ghareeb hai aur ismein bahut si aisi umda baatein hain jo dusri rivayaton mein nahi, Sirat Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke Abdullah bin Ubayy munafiq ke bete Hazrat Abdullah R.A jo pake sache musalman the is waqe ke baad An-Hazrat ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur guzarish ki ke Ya Rasulullah ﷺ maine suna hai ke mere baap ne jo bakwaas ki hai uske badle aap ise qatal karna chahte hain, Agar yuhin hai toh iske qatal ka hukum aap kisi aur ko na kijiye, Main khud jaata hoon aur abhi iska sar aap ke kadmo tale daalta hoon, Qasam Allah ki qabila Khazraj ka ek ek shakhs jaanta hai ke mujhse zyada koi beta apne baap se ehsan-o-suluk aur mohabbat-o-izzat karne wala nahi (lekin main Farman-e-Rasul ﷺ par apne pyare baap ki gardan maarne ko taiyar hoon), Agar aap ne kisi aur ko yeh hukum diya aur usne ise maara toh mujhe dhar hai ke kahin josh-e-inteqam mein main ise na maar baithun aur zahir hai ke agar yeh harkat mujhse ho gayi toh main ek kafir ke badle ek musalman ko maar kar jahannami ban jaaunga, Aap mere baap ke qatal ka hukum dijiye, Aap ne farmaya nahi nahi main ise qatal karna nahi chahta, Hum toh isse aur narmi bartenge aur iske sath husn-o-suluk karenge jab tak woh hamare sath hai, Hazrat Ikrimah aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Zaid ka bayaan hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ apne lashkaro samet Madine pahunche toh is munafiq Abdullah bin Ubayy ke ladke Hazrat Abdullah R.A Madina Sharif ke darwaze par khade ho gaye, Talwaar khench li, Log Madina mein dakhil hone lage yahan tak ke unka baap aaya toh yeh farmane lage pare raho, Madina mein na jaao, Usne kaha kya baat hai? Mujhe kyun rok raha hai?

Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne farmaya tu Madina mein nahi ja sakta jab tak ke Allah ke Rasool ﷺ tere liye ijazat na dein, izzat wale aap hi hain aur tu zaleel hai, yeh ruk kar khada ho gaya yahan tak ke Rasool Kareem ﷺ tashreef laye aap ki aadat-e-mubarak thi ke lashkar ke aakhiri hisse mein hote thay aap ko dekh kar us munafiq ne apne bete ki shikayat ki aap ne un se pucha ke ise kyun rok rakha hai? Unhone kaha qasam hai Allah ki jab tak aap ki ijazat na ho yeh andar nahi ja sakta chunacha Huzoor ﷺ ne ijazat di ab Hazrat Abdullah R.A ne apne baap ko shehar mein dakhil hone diya, Musnad Humaidi mein hai ke aap ne apne walid se kaha jab tak tu apni zaban se yeh na kahe ke Rasool Allah ﷺ عزت wale aur main zaleel to Madina mein nahi ja sakta aur is se pehle Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar arz kiya tha ke ya Rasool Allah ﷺ apne baap ki haibat ki wajah se main ne aaj tak nigaah oonchi kar ke un ke chehre ko bhi nahi dekha lekin aap agar is par naraz hain toh mujhe hukum dijiye abhi is ki gardan hazir karta hoon kisi aur ko is ke qatal ka hukum na dijiye aisa na ho ke main apne baap ke qatal ko apni aankhon se chalta phirta na dekh sakoon.

Maal-o-daulat ki khud-supurdgi kharabi ki jar hai. Allah Ta'ala apne momin bandon ko hukum deta hai ki woh bakasrat zikrullah kiya karein aur tanbih karta hai ki aisa na ho ki maal-o-aulad ki mohabbat mein phans kar zikrullah se ghafil ho jao, phir farmata hai ki jo zikrullah se ghafil ho jaye aur duniya ki zeenat hi ko sab kuch samajh baithe, apne Rab ki itaat mein sust par jaye, woh apna nuqsan aap karne wala hai. 

Phir apni itaat mein maal kharch karne ka hukum de raha hai aur farmata hai ki apni maut se pehle kharch kar lo, maut ke waqt ki be-basi dekh kar nadim hona aur umadein bandhna kuch nafa na dega. Us waqt insan chahega ki thodi si der ke liye bhi agar chhor diya jaye toh jo kuch naik amal ho sake kar le aur apna maal bhi dil khol kar rah-e-Khuda de le, lekin ah! ab waqt kahan, aane wali museebat aan pari aur na talne wali aafat sar par khari ho gayi. Aur jagah farman hai (tarjuma) al-khu, yaani logon ko hoshiyar kar de jis din inke paas azab aayega toh yeh zalim kahne lagenge: "A-hamare Rab! Hamein thodi si mohlat mil jaye taaki hum teri dawat qabool kar lein aur tere rasoolon ki itbaa karein." Is aayat mein toh kafiron ki muzammat ka zikr hai, doosri aayat mein naik amal mein kami karne walon ke afsos ka bayaan is tarah hua hai: (tarjuma) yaani jab inmein se kisi ko maut aane lagti hai toh kehta hai: "Mere Rab! Mujhe lautaa de taaki main naik amaal kar loon." 

Yahan farmata hai: "Maut ka waqt aage-piche nahi hota, Allah khud khabar rakhne wala hai ki kaun apne qoul mein sadiq hai aur apne sawal mein haq-bajanib hai." Yeh log toh agar lautaye jayein toh phir in baton ko bhool jayenge aur wahi kuch karne lag jayenge jo isse pehle karte rahe. 

Tirmizi mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ki har woh shakhs jo maaldar ho aur usne hajj na kiya ho ya zakat na di ho, woh maut ke waqt duniya mein wapas lautne ki aarzoo karta hai. Ek shakhs ne kaha: "Hazrat! Allah ka khauf kijiye, wapsi ki aarzoo toh kafir karte hain." Aapne farmaya: "Jaldi kyun karte ho? Suno, Quran farmata hai..." Phir aap ne yeh poora ruku tilawat kar sunaya. Usne poocha: "Zakat kitne mein wajib hai?" Farmaya: "Do sau aur isse zyada mein." Poocha: "Hajj kab farz ho jata hai?" Farmaya: "Jab rah-e-kharch aur sawari-e-kharch ki taaqat ho." 

Ek marfoo riwayat bhi is tarah marwi hai lekin mauqoof hi zyada sahih hai. Zahhak ki riwayat Ibn Abbas (R.A) wali bhi munqati hai, doosri sanad mein ek raawi Abu Janab Kalbi hai, woh bhi zaeif hai. Wallahu A'lam. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki ek martaba Huzoor ﷺ ke samne sahaba ne ziyadati-e-umr ka zikr kiya toh aapne farmaya: "Jab ajal aa jaye phir muakhar nahi hoti. Ziyadati-e-umr sirf is tarah hai ki Allah Ta'ala kisi bande ko naik saleh aulaad de jo uske liye uske marne ke baad dua karti rahe aur dua use uski qabr mein pahunchti rahe." 

Allah ke fazl-o-karam aur lutf-o-raham se Surah Al-Munafiqun ki tafsir khatam hui. Fa-Alhamdulillah.
